name: minimalPremium
title: Minimal Premium
description: Architectural clarity, generous white space, subtle slate gradients, pristine typography, and smooth, seamless mathematical eases.
do: Maintain strict grid alignment and comfortable margin padding
Pair subtle geometric accents with restrained desaturated tones
Use smooth deceleration curves for seamless elegance
dont: Do not clutter screens with gratuitous decorative shapes
Avoid harsh high-contrast saturated drop shadows
Never use jarring glitch or erratic camera shakes
